about: Milton is a fast-growing town in Halton Region, at the foot of the Niagara Escarpment west of Toronto. It has shifted from a small county town to one of Canada’s fastest-growing municipalities, with new subdivisions around a historic downtown. The escarpment and conservation areas sit immediately to the west. About 130,000 people live in Milton.
